notes: The Bernal Heights papers in the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers: the Bernal Heights Pictorial (1964), the Bernal Heights Journal and Bernal Journal (1965 to 1986) and the New Bernal Journal (1987 to 2008), 178 issues. These items have no hOCR, so the text of each was rebuilt from its _djvu.xml, one page object per leaf (/mnt/project-files/mission-papers/dl_djvu.py); citations give the issue month and the leaf. Read by hand, with no reader pass; extra.candidate is the row key in /mnt/project-files/mission-papers/decisions_bernal.py. Kept: what happened to a building (a fire, a move, a groundbreaking, a house built or shifted) and businesses and institutions as occupants. Not kept: members' and officers' home addresses, block-club contacts, garage-sale and open-studio lists, realtors' sold lists, meeting places, advertisements with no event, and anything about who lives in a house. Much of the later paper is the Bernal Heights Neighborhood Center's own newsletter, so its housing developments elsewhere in the city (1652 Eddy, 5199 Mission, 275 10th) are here too. extra.number_as_printed keeps 3364 Mission, the Mariani address the paper places on the Safeway site at 3350. extra.unknown_sentence states where the paper and the assessor's roll disagree. extra.placed_apn marks a held fact's parcel.

coverage.remaining: Nothing in this title: all 178 issues in the collection were read.
coverage.note: 178 issues; 6,174 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (ocr_mentions.py --rescue --untyped CORTLAND). The filter kept 613 windows, merged into 446 passages, all read by hand. 62 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 59 placed on a parcel: 43 published on 37 pages (15 seeded), 16 held as single thin facts on parcels with no page (mostly shop openings on Cortland Avenue and Mission Street). 3 unplaced at numbers no parcel carries today: 336 Elsie (a Water Department house of 1871, gone in 1971), 517 Cortland (the Pangaea arts center, 1976) and 3386 Mission (Jim's Donuts, 1970 to 1983). One candidate was dropped because the paper prints an address that does not exist (the Roccapulco Supper Club at '3240 Mission'). The audit flagged three and all stood on reading: the OCR prints 'Jime 24' for June 24, 1988; the Mariani fact is filed at the Safeway's number by design; Hunan Chef's 1996 opening is its 'ninth anniversary' of 2005, and a December 1996 advertisement announces the grand opening. Later the same day the held fact on 3223 Mission Street (bernal-journals-0042) was published, when the Bay Area Reporter's 1971-1975 batch gave the parcel a second fact and a page.
